3140.name: Quicksilver Sash
3140.note: Active removes crowd control: can break out of Bandage Toss / Curse of the Sad Mummy.

3139.name: Mercurial Scimitar
3139.note: QSS upgrade: cleanses your engage CC. Bait it out before committing R.

6035.name: Silvermere Dawn
6035.note: QSS upgrade for bruisers/tanks; cleanses CC.

3102.name: Banshee's Veil
3102.note: Spell shield can block Bandage Toss — pop it before engaging on the carrier.

3814.name: Edge of Night
3814.note: Spell shield (after channel) can block Bandage Toss.

3157.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
3157.note: Stasis wastes your R / burst; wait it out.

3153.name: Blade of the Ruined King
3153.note: Current-HP damage shreds tanks; don't front-line it alone for long.

3033.name: Mortal Reminder
3033.note: Grievous Wounds cuts Gwen's passive healing.

3123.name: Executioner's Calling
3123.note: Early Grievous Wounds — your passive sustain is weaker in extended trades.

3075.name: Thornmail
3075.note: Grievous Wounds when you auto them; less relevant than vs pure AD on-hit, but cuts healing.

3076.name: Bramble Vest
3076.note: Thornmail component: early Grievous Wounds on your autos.

6609.name: Chempunk Chainsword
6609.note: Bruiser Grievous Wounds — common on top laners.

3156.name: Maw of Malmortius
3156.note: Magic-damage lifeline shield blunts your all-in; trade around its cooldown.

4401.name: Force of Nature
4401.note: Stacking MR makes them much harder to kill as a magic-damage champion.

3065.name: Spirit Visage
3065.note: MR + increased healing: extended trades get worse.

3111.name: Mercury's Treads
3111.note: Tenacity shortens your CC chain and adds MR.

3074.name: Ravenous Hydra
3074.note: Big wave clear + healing spike on fighters (e.g. Fiora).

3077.name: Tiamat
3077.note: Hydra component: stronger short trades and wave clear.

3071.name: Black Cleaver
3071.note: Armor shred stacks on you in extended fights.

3036.name: Lord Dominik's Regards
3036.note: Armor penetration vs bonus-HP targets — tanks take a lot more damage.

3302.name: Terminus
3302.note: Penetration that ramps in long fights against tanks.

6610.name: Sundered Sky
6610.note: Guaranteed crit + healing on fighters; longer trades favor them.

3053.name: Sterak's Gage
3053.note: Shield on burst — your all-in has to outlast it.
